_comment: Per-function literature and model queries for the global health gap map sweep. Europe PMC query syntax. CHW is the shared cadre filter.
chw: ("community health worker*" OR "community health volunteer*" OR "lay health worker*" OR "ASHA worker*" OR "accredited social health activist*" OR "health extension worker*" OR "frontline health worker*")
lmic: ("low-income" OR "middle-income" OR LMIC OR "low-resource" OR "resource-limited" OR Africa OR India OR Asia OR "Latin America")

2.2.A1.name: Local-language voice-to-form for health workers
queries: ("speech recognition" OR "voice input" OR "speech-to-text" OR "voice-based data") AND {chw}
("automatic speech recognition" OR "speech-to-text" OR "voice input") AND ("data collection" OR "data entry" OR documentation) AND {lmic}

2.5.4.name: Transmit non-routine health event alerts to health workers
queries: (alert OR notification OR "early warning") AND (SMS OR mobile OR WhatsApp) AND {chw} AND (outbreak OR emergency)
("health worker" AND (alert OR broadcast) AND (outbreak OR epidemic) AND mobile AND {lmic})

2.7.2.name: Schedule health worker's activities (incl. CHW household-visit prioritization)
queries: ("risk prediction" OR "machine learning" OR prioriti*) AND ("household visit*" OR "home visit*") AND {chw}
("route optimization" OR microplanning OR "workload") AND {chw} AND (algorithm OR digital)

3.1.A1.name: Supervisor copilot and supportive supervision analytics
queries: (supervision OR supervisor*) AND (dashboard OR analytics OR "machine learning" OR "performance data") AND {chw}
("supportive supervision" AND (digital OR mobile OR mHealth) AND {chw})

2.3.A1.name: Guideline-grounded protocol Q&A
queries: (chatbot OR "large language model" OR LLM OR "conversational agent" OR RAG) AND (guideline* OR protocol*) AND ("health worker*" OR nurse* OR midwi*) AND {lmic}

2.3.A3.name: Treat-or-refer decision support at the household
queries: (IMCI OR iCCM OR "integrated community case management") AND (digital OR electronic OR mobile OR algorithm)

1.6.A2.name: Local-language voice interface for clients
queries: (IVR OR "interactive voice response" OR "voice assistant" OR "voice chatbot") AND health AND {lmic}

2.2.A2.name: Digitizing paper registers and checking data quality at capture
queries: (OCR OR "optical character recognition" OR "handwriting recognition" OR "paper-based" digiti*) AND (register* OR form*) AND health AND {lmic}

huggingface._comment: Enabling layer (5.1). Language codes for priority LMIC languages; each is a Hub language filter.
